# GrantEvent

`schemas/records/grant-event.json`

The payload of every grant event (docs/design/m0/04 "Grants", "Read authorization"): &lt;transition&gt;/v1, i.e. grant.created/v1 or grant.revoked/v1, with the grant as issued and, once revoked, when. The event's subject is the grant. A narrowing is a revocation and a new grant. internal/authority checks every transition against the current record in the writer transaction; long-lived streams re-check authority against these records.

## Fields of the document

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `transition` | yes | one of `grant.created`, `grant.revoked` |  |
| `grant` | yes | [grant](records-grant.md) |  |
| `revoked_at` | yes | null or [Time](common-defs.md#time) |  |

No other fields are allowed.

Conditional rules (1, `if`/`then`/`else` in the schema):

- when `transition` `grant.created`, then `revoked_at` `null`; otherwise `revoked_at` any (not `null`)
